blocks.text: NEW YORK — Jalen Brunson scored 30 points, Mikel Bridges hit the winning 3-pointer at the buzzer, and the New York Knicks edged the Portland Trail Blazers 97-96 on Saturday night. The defending champions led by 26 points in the first half before Portland charged back and took a 96-94 lead with 3.4 seconds left after a pair of free throws from Deni Avdija. New York called a timeout to advance the ball past half court and Josh Hart found Bridges on the wing as Toumani Camara leapt past him.
